---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::stringtie=3.0.3

---
name: "nf-core/stringtie/stringtie"
description: "Transcript assembly and quantification for RNA-Se"
keywords:
- "transcript"
- "assembly"
- "quantification"
- "gtf"
tools:
- stringtie:
    description: "Transcript assembly and quantification for RNA-Seq\n"
    homepage: "https://ccb.jhu.edu/software/stringtie/index.shtml"
    documentation: "https://ccb.jhu.edu/software/stringtie/index.shtml?t=manual"
    doi: "10.1186/s13059-019-1910-1"
    publication:
      author: "Kovaka, S., Zimin, A. V., Pertea, G. M., Razaghi, R., Salzberg, S.\
        \ L. & Pertea, M."
      year: 2019
      title: "Transcriptome assembly from long-read RNA-seq alignments with StringTie2"
      source: "Genome Biology"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:stringtie"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test', strandedness:'forward'\
        \ ]\n"
  - srbam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Sorted and indexed bam file from short-read alignment.\n"
      pattern: ".bam"
      ontologies: []
  - lrbam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Sorted and indexed bam file from long-read alignment.\n"
      pattern: ".bam"
      ontologies: []
- mode:
    type: "string"
    description: "StringTie mode (long-read-assembly, mix-read-assembly, expression-estimation,\
      \ nascent-aware-assembly).\n"
    enum:
    - "long-read-assembly"
    - "mix-read-assembly"
    - "expression-estimation"
    - "nascent-aware-assembly"
- annotation_gtf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Annotation gtf file (optional).\n"
    pattern: ".gtf"
    ontologies: []
output:
  transcript_gtf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ strandedness:'forward' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.transcripts.gtf:
        type: "file"
        description: "Output assembly (transcriptome)\n"
        pattern: ".gtf"
        ontologies: []
  abundance:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ strandedness:'forward' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.gene.abundance.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Abundance for non-redundand set of transcripts\n"
        pattern: ".txt"
        ontologies: []
  coverage_gtf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ strandedness:'forward' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.coverage.gtf:
        type: "file"
        description: "Coverage for the sample\n"
        pattern: ".gtf"
        ontologies: []
  ballgown:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ strandedness:'forward' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.ballgown/*.ctab:
        type: "file"
        description: "Ballgown output for the sample\n"
        pattern: ".ctab"
        ontologies: []
  versions_stringtie:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - stringtie:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - stringtie --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - stringtie:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - stringtie --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@drpatelh"
- "@khersameesh24"
maintainers:
- "@drpatelh"
- "@khersameesh24"
version: "0.0.0-c87ca93"
license: "MIT License"
